#### 1. D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria 1  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.285)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-880009)

**Proposed mechanism:** L2HGDH (HGNC:6693) —DECREASES→ L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid (CHEBI:16820); L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid (CHEBI:16820) —LEADS_TO→ Metabolic disruption leading to oxidative stress and impaired neurodevelopment (GO:0008150); D2HGDH (HGNC:27449) —DECREASES→ D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid (CHEBI:17978); D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid (CHEBI:17978) —LEADS_TO→ Metabolic disruption leading to oxidative stress and impaired neurodevelopment (GO:0008150); Metabolic disruption leading to oxidative stress and impaired neurodevelopment (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Metabolic disruption leading to oxidative stress and impaired neurodevelopment (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); Metabolic disruption leading to oxidative stress and impaired neurodevelopment (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Hypotonia (HP:0001252).
